title: As the Gods Will
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bored high school student Shun Takahata wants excitement, until his teacher's head explodes and his classmates are forced into deadly versions of children's games such as Daruma-san ga Koronda. Not knowing who is behind the games or when they will end, Shun and the survivors must outlast each round, and each other.
life_message: Survival under arbitrary, god-like power rewards wit and teamwork, and exposes what a bored life took for granted.
